rejected_c3.decision: numeric gate failed; preserve all complete original observations and never rerun this source to select a faster sample

prior_c4.decision: Complete development comparison retained, insufficient public token speed margin. C4 formal runner/workflow were prepared but never bound or executed. No same-source timing retry.

substantive_change: Retain C4 metadata pruning and existing C3 exact suffix, covering-index and bounded SQLite pager work. Add one lazy bounded memo of exact full text token counts owned by each MemoryBook.

This explicitly extends C4's no-persistent-feature-cache scope. Query-result caching remains disabled/cleared exactly as before; derived token-count reuse is enabled in ordinary product behavior and measured as part of the candidate.

For certified ordinary TokenCounter instances, eligible exact native str inputs beginning with [ and containing LF plus nonempty evidence may reuse the count of the complete unchanged text with the same certified Encoding/CoreBPE objects. No normalization, digest-only keys, page identifiers or retrieved-result reuse.

Implement inside the ordinary count method, without replacing it or altering downstream sealed-boundary method identity. Preserve all SQL retrieval, source corruption checks, assembly, provenance, score, budget and response behavior.

Use a shared LRU for both tokenizer names, at most 2048 entries and 2097152 retained text-object bytes per MemoryBook. Measure sys.getsizeof(text) after successful encoding. Oversized text bypasses storage without flushing normal entries. Container/key/value/encoder overhead is separately disclosed and actual RSS remains measured.

Retain exact Encoding/CoreBPE object identities; identity changes invalidate memo generation and sealing certification. Check identity again before insertion. Unknown versions/patterns, customized class/instance methods, subclass counters/text and uncertified implementations use the original exact path. Do not retain an unbounded history of encoder generations.

Lazily allocate only for token-budget recalls. Standalone TokenCounter without a connection memo retains its old behavior. Clear retained text at MemoryBook.close, including exceptional close cleanup. Encoding errors are never memoized.
invariants: Unchanged route SQL limits/global BM25, lexical normalization, fusion arithmetic, scopes, source text/addresses, final score expressions and top-K tie order.
Unchanged source corruption checks, source snapshots, exact character/token budgets, MCP payload/envelope, result-cache behavior, schema version and dependency requirements.
Exact complete non-timing payload equivalence against published v0.3.2, including candidate_count and truncated, across retained regression configurations.

cache_policy.ownership: one MemoryBook connection; both encoders share limits
cache_policy.cold_warm_boundary: Preserve original connection lifecycles, configuration order and shuffled query orders. Each fresh connection starts empty; native later token configurations can reuse prior counts on that connection. Each actual MCP configuration starts a fresh official server process. No extra prewarming, no discarded first queries, and no selective cache clearing.
cache_policy.diagnostics: Save native memo state before/after every configuration outside timing, including start/hits/misses/evictions/entries/text bytes and cold-prefix observations where available. Preserve original actual SDK MCP command, protocol and measured envelope; private memo counters are not exposed over MCP. Its cold process boundary and actual process RSS are recorded. Do not describe this experiment as disabling every cache.

requirements: Before timing, verify first count/hit/LRU bounds, both encoders, exact Unicode/special-token text, oversized and exceptional cases, identity/custom fallbacks, close cleanup and source corruption after memo warming.

Commit exact C5 runtime and tests, then run one full native development invocation with both complete old cohorts, all four configurations and AB/BA rounds. Save every worker and adverse observation. A source fix after a failed run requires a new explicitly registered source/attempt.
Verify final-source historical Hotpot256 default complete payload compatibility before release; do not relabel C3 compatibility or old competitor timing as C5 evidence.

formal_protocol.evaluator: A separately named C5 runner/workflow adapts source/provenance/path/claim registration and adds read-only native memo diagnostics outside timing. Retain frozen original measurement arithmetic, datasets, configurations, ABBA order, equality and all numerical gates. Keep C3 and C4 evaluator files unchanged.
formal_protocol.binding: Commit final materially changed C5 source, evaluator and tests, then create and commit one new C5 binding before its sole exclusive formal execution.
formal_protocol.decision: All correctness and numeric gates must pass; any resource trigger needs explicit independent review. No earlier source gain substitutes for a missing C5 gate.

release: No v0.3.3 runtime approval, main advance or release branch until final acceptance and exact-source nine-job CI.
